name: Moonstone Stereo
direction: Vintage hi-fi instrument: smoked walnut, brushed aluminum, warm ivory workspaces, charcoal sidebars and soft mint signal lights. Original Apple/Linux Mint silhouette recast as opal-blue/celadon enamel with champagne LM and nickel rim; fine dial markings compose a central medallion.

geometry.composition: Continuous slim aluminum status rail with recessed instruments; low horizontal stereo receiver with artwork, transport and audio-reactive low/high spectrum meters; ivory app canvas/charcoal navigation.

preservation: Original wallpapers and supplied logo geometry
Custom music commands and playback behavior

wallpaper.description: Smoked walnut with composed inset medallion, opal/celadon Apple LM enamel, champagne monogram, nickel rim and restrained hi-fi dial engravings

brand_color_source: Authored Moonstone enamel finish, original supplied file preserves geometry only

brand_finish.body: Opal-blue and celadon enamel with natural mineral strata
brand_finish.monogram: Champagne metal inlay preserving supplied LM geometry
